description: This file defines a mock class MediaFrameWriterMock for unit testing, which implements the IMediaFrameWriter interface. It includes mock methods for writing media frames and retrieving the number of frames, and is part of the firebolt::rialto::common namespace.

classes.name: MediaFrameWriterMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of IMediaFrameWriter for testing purposes, providing mocked methods for writing frames and retrieving frame count.

methods.name: writeFrame
methods.description: Mock method to simulate writing a media frame, taking a unique pointer to a MediaSegment.

methods.name: getNumFrames
methods.description: Mock method to retrieve the number of frames processed.
